name: VRM_MEA_DOC_CARVEOUT_LINES_GT
description: The VRM_MEA_DOC_CARVEOUT_LINES_GT table contains information about carve-out adjustments.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Document line unique identifier.

columns.name: MEA_ID
columns.description: Multiple element arrangement unique identifier.

columns.name: DELIVERED_FLAG
columns.description: Stores the fulfillment status of the MEA line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Stores the processing status of the carve-out line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of MEA adjustment. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_ADJ_PROCESS_STATUS.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit revenue price after a carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revenue line amount for a MEA line after a carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_UNIT_LIST_PRICE_DISC
columns.description: Percent of discount  after a carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_BASE_PRICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Percent of base price after a carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_REASON
columns.description: Reason code for creating the carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: CARVEOUT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Carve-out amount processed for a MEA line.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether carve out is reversed. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: DISPLAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the latest activity. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Used to identify if revenue recognition has used this carve-out line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_DATE
columns.description: Line carve-out adjustment date.

columns.name: PARENT_MEA_CARVEOUT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the original adjustment line.

columns.name: ADJ_GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: Percent of gross margin after a carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Date the carve-out line was processed.

columns.name: CARVEOUT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Stores the difference between line amount and adjusted amount in percentage for the carve-out lines.

columns.name: MEA_CARVEOUT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Carve-out adjustments unique identifier.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the FMV line.

columns.name: TOTAL_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total line amount of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: TOTAL_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total fair market value amount of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: FMV_REPRESENTATION_TYPE
columns.description: FMV representation type. Values are from the lookup VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_CODE
columns.description: The fair market value tolerance range level used to calculate the carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: SUGGESTED_CARVEOUT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Suggested carve-out amount of the MEA.

columns.name: SUGGESTED_CARVEOUT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Percent of suggested carve-out of the MEA.

columns.name: MANUALLY_ENTERED_FLAG
columns.description: Used to identify the manually added carve-out line. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.description: Delivery status used to calculate the carve-out adjustment. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_ACTION
columns.description: Adjustment action for MEA line. Values are from the lookup  VRM_MEA_LINE_ACTION_TYPE.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Net unit price used to calculate the carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_LIST_PRICE_DISC

columns.name: NET_BASE_PRICE_PERCENT

columns.name: NET_GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT

columns.name: NET_COST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Net cost amount used to calculate the carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: CURRENT_LINE_AMOUNT_PROCESSED
columns.description: Current line amount processed by carve-out.

columns.description: Carve-out amount processed for a MEA line.

columns.description: The user comments on MEA adjustments.

columns.name: MEA_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total fair market values of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: EXTENDED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total line amounts of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the document line.

columns.name: DEFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Specifies whether the revenue for the MEA line is deferred or not. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_HIGH_PCT
columns.description: High value percent of the VSOE value tolerance range.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_LOW_PCT
columns.description: Low value percent of the VSOE value tolerance range.

columns.name: PREV_CARVEOUT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Original carve-out adjustment identifier.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price that is used to validate VSOE value of a MEA line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Unit list price used to calculate carve-out amount.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of a transaction line.

columns.name: REVISED_COST
columns.description: The revised cost of the revenue recognition source line.

columns.name: DELIVERY_STATUS
columns.description: Fulfillment status of a source document line. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS.

columns.name: NEW_DEFERRED_FLAG
columns.description: Used to identify released deferred revenue. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Source document line number.

columns.name: REV_CARVEOUT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Release deferred carve-out adjustments unique identifier.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Used to identify element type for a line. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.
